description:
Are you passionate about using machine learning to replace hours of physics simulation with milliseconds of inference? At Falcomm, we are building GaNdalph.ai, an AI-native RF chip design platform that turns design cycles of months into minutes. We are seeking a full-time AI/ML Software Engineer to build and ship the models that predict electromagnetic and thermal behavior of on-chip structures. Your models will stand in for slow field solvers inside the design loop, so the platform can explore thousands of layouts where a human team could try a handful. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and applied physics.
 We are seeking an engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, cares about measurable accuracy, and is motivated to ship working product. This is a product role: your models decide the geometry of real chips.
 
 
 Responsibilities
 Surrogate Models: Build, train, and ship models that predict the electromagnetic response of passives such as inductors, transformers, baluns, and matching networks directly from layout geometry.
 Dataset Generation: Automate large-scale simulation campaigns with EM solvers to create training data across foundry metal stacks.
 Inverse Design: Develop optimization and generative methods that go from a target response to a manufacturable layout.
 Thermal Modeling: Extend the surrogate approach to heat flow in high-power-density designs.
 Accuracy and Trust: Quantify model error and uncertainty, and automatically fall back to full simulation when a prediction is outside its trusted range.
 Production Integration: Package and serve models for fast inference inside the GaNdalph.ai design flow.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with EM design engineers and layout engineers to turn design rules and physical constraints into deployable software.
 Requirements 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
 3+ years of professional experience in machine learning or software engineering.
 Experience shipping machine learning models into production, not only training them.
 Proficiency in Python: object-oriented programming, automation, and testing.
 ML Framework Expertise: Experience building models with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
 Experience with models for spatial or geometric data, such as convolutional networks, graph neural networks, or neural operators.
 Software Fundamentals: Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, numerical methods, and version control (Git).
 
 
 Preferred Qualifications
 PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with an emphasis on RF/microwave integrated circuit design.
 Physics-informed machine learning or surrogate modeling for simulation.
 Hands-on experience with EM simulation tools (Ansys HFSS, Cadence EMX, Keysight Momentum) or open-source alternatives (openEMS).
 Knowledge of chip layout formats and tools (GDSII, gdsfactory, KLayout).
 Experience with Bayesian optimization, active learning, or generative models for design.
 Simulation Scripting: Familiarity with automating simulations through SKILL, AEL, or Python APIs.
 Understanding of RF concepts such as S-parameters, impedance matching, and quality factor.
 Benefits 
 Competitive Salary and Equity Package
 Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
 401(k) Retirement Plan
 Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave
 
 DISCLOSURE
 Falcomm is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Falcomm is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.
 Applicants wishing to view a copy of Falcomm’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should notify Falcomm.
 To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
